description: Na₃CaLaP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.99 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.66 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.45 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-44°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-42°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂CaP trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃LaP trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaP trigonal pyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂CaP trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃LaP trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃LaP trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaP trigonal pyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one La, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃LaP trigonal bipyramids.
